# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_reference.py from the Click command tree. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page is generated from the command definitions in `nexus_symbiote.cli` and its
registered command modules. Each section reproduces what `nexus-symbiote <command> --help`
prints, rendered at a terminal width of 100 columns; a narrower terminal wraps the same
text differently. The installed version's own `--help` output is authoritative where the
two differ, because this page describes the `main` branch.

Regenerate the page after changing a command:

```sh
python scripts/generate_cli_reference.py --write
```

`python scripts/generate_cli_reference.py --check` prints a diff and exits 1 when the page
is stale. `tests/test_cli_reference.py` makes the same comparison in the test suite.

Exit codes, policy files and command workflows are described in the
[quick start](../getting-started/quickstart.md) and
[configuration](../getting-started/configuration.md) pages.

## `nexus-symbiote`

Nexus SymBiote — Agent Bill of Materials for AI supply chain security.

```text
Usage: nexus-symbiote [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Nexus SymBiote — Agent Bill of Materials for AI supply chain security.

  Every command runs offline unless --live is given (or NEXUS_SYMBIOTE_MODE=live): no network access
  and no process execution. discover-mcp, advisories and verify-live need --live to contact a server
  or start a launcher; with --input they analyze a saved export offline instead.

  Exit codes: 0 complete and within policy; 1 usage, configuration, input or output failure; 2 a
  gate or verification failed on complete evidence; 3 incomplete collection or observation, or a
  live step refused offline.

Options:
  --version  Show the version and exit.
  --offline  Refuse network access and process execution for this run (the default).
  --live     Permit the live steps of discover-mcp, advisories and verify-live.
  --help     Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  advisories         Find OSV advisories for the exact PyPI/npm package URLs in the inventory.
  baseline           Stage a static snapshot for review; publish it only after the scan gate...
  blast-radius       Show repository dependencies potentially affected by a component compromise.
  diff               Compare two AIBOM snapshots for supply-chain drift.
  discover-mcp       Observe tools/list without executing tools or starting local servers.
  import-shadowscan  Import a Nexus-ShadowScan report and generate an AIBOM of imported claims.
  init               Initialize a .nexus-symbiote.yaml policy configuration.
  risk               Score supply-chain risks in an AIBOM.
  runtime            Sign and verify purpose-specific contracts for mediated tool integrations.
  scan               Scan a project and generate an AIBOM.
  summary            Print a summary of an AIBOM.
  validate           Validate an AIBOM for completeness and integrity.
  verify-artifact    Verify a local artifact's digest and optionally its Sigstore bundle.
  verify-discovery   Verify source bytes and optionally their native projection and producer.
  verify-live        Compare served MCP tool descriptors with the inventory; optionally emit an...
  vex                Export schema-validated findings in triage, without asserting exploitability.
```

## `nexus-symbiote advisories`

Find OSV advisories for the exact PyPI/npm package URLs in the inventory.

```text
Usage: nexus-symbiote advisories [OPTIONS] AIBOM_PATH

  Find OSV advisories for the exact PyPI/npm package URLs in the inventory.

  Live (needs --live): queries the OSV API over pinned HTTPS. Offline: --input matches a saved OSV
  export, evaluating listed versions and ECOSYSTEM/SEMVER ranges; entries it cannot evaluate make
  the result incomplete instead of clean.

Options:
  -o, --output PATH
  --input PATH       Offline: match a saved OSV export (all.zip, a directory of records or a JSON
                     file).
  --help             Show this message and exit.
```

## `nexus-symbiote baseline`

Stage a static snapshot for review; publish it only after the scan gate passes.

```text
Usage: nexus-symbiote baseline [OPTIONS] [PROJECT_PATH]

  Stage a static snapshot for review; publish it only after the scan gate passes.

  The file is unsigned. Operators must review and authenticate the baseline before using it as an
  authority for runtime admission.

Options:
  -o, --baseline-path PATH
  --help                    Show this message and exit.
```

## `nexus-symbiote diff`

Compare two AIBOM snapshots for supply-chain drift.

```text
Usage: nexus-symbiote diff [OPTIONS] OLD_PATH NEW_PATH

  Compare two AIBOM snapshots for supply-chain drift.

Options:
  --json-output     Output as JSON
  --fail-on-change  Exit 2 when the snapshots differ, for a drift gate in CI.
  --help            Show this message and exit.
```

## `nexus-symbiote discover-mcp`

Observe tools/list without executing tools or starting local servers.

```text
Usage: nexus-symbiote discover-mcp [OPTIONS] [ENDPOINT]

  Observe tools/list without executing tools or starting local servers.

  Live (needs --live): one bounded HTTPS session to ENDPOINT, whose origin must be approved with
  --allowed-origin. Offline: --input reads a saved tools/list result, a JSON-RPC response carrying
  one, or a JSON list of result pages, and applies the same checks; ENDPOINT then only labels the
  report.

Options:
  --allowed-origin TEXT  Exact HTTPS origin explicitly approved by the operator; required for live
                         discovery
  --token-env TEXT       Environment variable holding a bearer token; the token is never written to
                         evidence
  --input FILE           Analyze a saved tools/list result offline instead of contacting ENDPOINT
  -o, --output PATH
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
```

## `nexus-symbiote import-shadowscan`

Import a Nexus-ShadowScan report and generate an AIBOM of imported claims.

```text
Usage: nexus-symbiote import-shadowscan [OPTIONS] REPORT_PATH

  Import a Nexus-ShadowScan report and generate an AIBOM of imported claims.

  This is the recommended primary workflow: run ShadowScan for discovery, then Nexus SymBiote for
  verification, integrity, and BOM emission.

Options:
  -o, --output PATH               Output AIBOM path  [required]
  -f, --format [json|cyclonedx|spdx|sarif]
  --report-only                   Emit imported claims without a CI gate failure
  --no-project-policy             Use built-in policy without reading configuration near the report.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```

```text

Options:
```

Verify purpose, signer, subject and time; invocation uses ReferenceGateway.

```text
Usage: nexus-symbiote runtime verify [OPTIONS] ENVELOPE_PATH

  Verify purpose, signer, subject and time; invocation uses ReferenceGateway.

  Unreadable or malformed inputs exit 1; a contract that fails verification exits 2.
```

## `nexus-symbiote verify-live`

Compare served MCP tool descriptors with the inventory; optionally emit an unsigned candidate.

```text
Usage: nexus-symbiote verify-live [OPTIONS] AIBOM_PATH

  Compare served MCP tool descriptors with the inventory; optionally emit an unsigned candidate.

  Live (needs --live): starts private copies of independently pinned stdio launchers. The operator
  provisions the launch policy outside the untrusted checkout; pins cover launcher bytes, so use an
  externally isolated worker to restrict host dependencies, filesystem, identity and egress.
  Offline: --input compares a recorded export and launches nothing. Descriptor matches do not
  establish safety.

Options:
  --project PATH
  --launch-policy FILE     Live: operator-owned JSON outside the project mapping exact server
                           references to absolute commands and SHA-256 pins.
  --input FILE             Offline: compare descriptors recorded by --save-descriptors instead of
                           launching servers.
  --save-descriptors PATH  Live: also write the observed descriptors for a later offline --input
                           comparison.
  --json-output
  --record
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
```
